result.title: AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces
result.summary: Decision models such as Jev return probabilities over caller-defined options and are increasingly used for classification. Large label spaces challenge both accuracy and scalability: larger menus can impair decisions, increase input costs, and exceed option limits. Hierarchical classification reduces menu size but introduces serial calls and error propagation. We propose AdaMenu, which builds a compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples and makes a single decision-model request. Its candidate labels adapt to the query, and its default setting also adjusts menu size using aggregated retrieval scores. We evaluate AdaMenu with open and closed decision models on four label sets containing up to 1,016 labels. It outperforms TypeSafe's beam-search baseline on all 16 model and label-set pairs where both methods run, improving accuracy by 16.6-34.3 percentage points. Relative to the full menu on the three smaller label sets, accuracy differences range from -0.5 to +7.2 percentage points, while input token usage falls by factors of 3.2-22.9. AdaMenu also runs when option limits exclude the full menu, including settings where the hierarchical baseline is unavailable.

AI.brief_summary: AdaMenu 针对大标签空间分类，用检索到的带标签样例为每个查询构建紧凑的候选标签菜单，只需一次决策模型调用，并默认按聚合检索分数调整菜单规模；在最多 1,016 个标签的四组标签集上优于 beam-search 层级基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按检索分数聚合自适应决定候选集大小、避免扩大选项集」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中的候选假设筛选与停止/计算预算分配问题，但论文本身面向纯文本分类，与视觉推理和 latent 状态无直接联系。
